context.target_user: Local service business operators, clinic directors, and medical/legal content writers
context.problem: Generating context-bound, multi-section educational guides that adhere strictly to verified clinical facts and negative boundaries without fabricating unoffered services.
context.use_case: Drafting comprehensive local educational articles (800-900 words) from structured briefs and clinician fact sheets.

rationale: In Benchmark Test 06, Claude 3.5 Sonnet produced an 835-word educational guide strictly adhering to all 6 required brief sections with zero hallucination of excluded shockwave/stem-cell modalities. It demonstrated industry-leading prompt constraint compliance and natural, professional healthcare tone.
when_to_consider: When drafting long-form educational articles where strict adherence to negative medical constraints is required.
When working from detailed, pre-structured content briefs and clinician fact sheets.
When calibrating tone for professional, empathetic local service communication.
when_not_to_use: When expecting autonomous web research or live competitor keyword volume analysis.
When unguided by explicit source facts, as open-ended prompts increase factual drift.
For automatic site auditing or CMS publishing without human editorial review.
